evidence: Row 31's authored-coverage rule is satisfied. In the frozen task, functional/prompt.md:190-197 requires all four distinct parent-document/storage results, while allowing app-owned title/status changes; :227-236 requires five separate unsupported-family runs and continued checks after failures; :242-267 checks both literal loops and the Promise loop; :311-356 checks both JS/HTML timer errors and all three rejection fixtures; :362-376 checks all four console levels, both object properties/nested value and all three array elements. S17 at :395-404 requires final-version-only debounce, exactly one manual execution through the pending window, and both New and saved-load cancellation. S21 at :418-424 reads both saved identities and checks monitor fields after save, update and load. S22 at :430-434 records and compares the whole actual library, each record exactly once, all recorded controlled history snapshots and immutable retry result, explicitly ignoring order/display metadata. S23 at :440-445 repeats all-three-field refusal/draft/reapply checks with roles reversed. S37 at :466-473 checks each saved revision's three fields once, all intervening snapshots after restore, both immediate and later-Save retries plus the lost-reply UI path, and complete current/history state on stale refusal. S38 at :477-480 separately dispatches Save/Save and Save/Restore, demanding exactly one whole-record winner, one conflict and one added snapshot. These plural bars agree with functional/judge.toml:336,350-357,490-497,504-581. Polish/prompt.md:45-49 enumerates every requested enabled control, allows composite navigation and legitimate disabled states; visual/prompt.md:42-43 covers all four desktop surfaces and the explicitly scoped two mobile surfaces. Legitimate side effects are not treated as invariant violations: functional/prompt.md:149 allows native input value changes after handler cancellation, :197 allows app-owned title changes, :207 allows a caught blocked operation's successful render, :384 allows non-log status/duration labels after Clear, and :431 ignores order/display metadata. Broken-app challenges: dropping just HTML Beta or a non-target record on restart violates :430-431; preserving only the newest history snapshot violates :466/:469/:472; accepting both racing requests or adding a phantom loser revision violates :479-480; blocking only eval while permitting Worker violates :227-236. Conforming alternatives with reordered library rows, refreshed display metadata, app title changes, composite keyboard menus or native input editing remain allowed. Raw evidence hashes independently match: evidence/31/hash-verification.json contains 137 checks with zero mismatches. history-results.json records both paired races as statuses [200,409] with one new whole-record revision, and its three original snapshots plus later history; post-results.json records the three actual pre-restart records and histories. These are limited scripted observations, not the complete prescribed S22 collection (Alpha/Beta were created in a later scripted phase), configured judge grades, private deterministic-checker execution or Oracle/model/portal evidence. This Pass concerns the text's whole-collection and side-effect contract only; it does not waive the separate runtime-measurement requirements.
